q.hi: RAG me LLM answer kis cheez ke basis pe likhta hai?
q.en: In RAG, what does the LLM base its answer on?

hi: Prompt me diye gaye retrieved chunks
Fine-tuned weights me store kiye docs
en: Retrieved chunks placed in the prompt

why.hi: RAG pehle relevant chunks retrieve karta hai aur unhe prompt me daalta hai; LLM usi context se answer deta hai.
why.en: RAG retrieves relevant chunks first and puts them in the prompt; the LLM answers from that context.

q.hi: Company docs har hafte badalte hain aur answers me citations chahiye. Best approach?
q.en: Company docs change every week and answers need citations. Best approach?

hi: Saare docs har request me long context me bhejo
RAG with re-indexing on doc change
en: Send all docs in long context on every request
RAG with re-indexing on doc change

why.hi: Fresh/private data aur citations ke liye RAG; doc badla to sirf re-index, retraining nahi.
why.en: RAG suits fresh/private data and citations; a changed doc only needs re-indexing, not retraining.

q.hi: Fine-tuning kis cheez ke liye sabse sahi hai?
q.en: What is fine-tuning best suited for?

hi: Output ka format, tone ya task behaviour badalna
Har hafte naye facts add karna
en: Changing output format, tone or task behaviour

why.hi: Fine-tuning behaviour/style sikhata hai; facts yaad karane ka reliable tareeka nahi aur citations nahi deta.
why.en: Fine-tuning teaches behaviour/style; it is not a reliable way to memorise facts and gives no citations.

q.hi: RAG pipeline me rerank step kahan aata hai?
q.en: Where does the rerank step sit in a RAG pipeline?

hi: Retrieve ke baad, generate se pehle

why.hi: Query path: retrieve top 20–50 → rerank to top 3–5 → LLM generate.
why.en: Query path: retrieve top 20–50 → rerank to top 3–5 → LLM generates.

q.hi: RAG bot galat answer de raha hai. Debug ka pehla step kya hona chahiye?
q.en: A RAG bot gives wrong answers. What should the first debugging step be?

hi: Check karo ki answer retrieved chunks me tha ya nahi
en: Check whether the answer was in the retrieved chunks

why.hi: Answer context me nahi tha to retrieval problem; tha to generation/prompt problem. Pehle ye alag karo.
why.en: If the answer was not in the context it is a retrieval problem; if it was, it is a generation/prompt problem. Separate these first.

q.hi: User error code 'ERR_CONN_RESET_4XX' poochta hai par retrieval galat docs laata hai. Kaunsa fix sabse relevant hai?
q.en: A user asks about error code 'ERR_CONN_RESET_4XX' but retrieval returns the wrong docs. Which fix is most relevant?

why.hi: Dense embeddings exact identifiers ko blur kar dete hain; BM25 exact tokens pakadta hai, isliye hybrid.
why.en: Dense embeddings blur exact identifiers; BM25 catches exact tokens, hence hybrid.

q.hi: Semantic search kis cheez ko match karta hai?
q.en: What does semantic search match?

why.hi: Embeddings meaning capture karte hain, isliye 'khana thanda aaya' aur 'cold food refund' paas aate hain.
why.en: Embeddings capture meaning, so 'food came cold' and 'refund for cold food' land close together.

q.hi: Kis query pe pure dense semantic search sabse kamzor hoga?
q.en: On which query is pure dense semantic search weakest?

why.hi: SKU jaise exact identifiers embedding me blur ho jaate hain; yahan keyword/BM25 strong hai.
why.en: Exact identifiers like SKUs get blurred in embeddings; keyword/BM25 is strong here.

q.hi: Query aur documents ko alag embedding models se embed kiya. Kya hoga?
q.en: Queries and documents were embedded with different models. What happens?

hi: Vectors alag spaces me hain, similarity scores bekaar
Koi fark nahi agar dims same hain
en: Vectors live in different spaces, similarity scores are meaningless

why.hi: Same model zaroori hai; alag models ke vectors comparable nahi hote, dims same hon tab bhi.
why.en: The same model is required; vectors from different models are not comparable, even with equal dimensions.

q.hi: Bi-encoder retrieval itna fast kyun hai?
q.en: Why is bi-encoder retrieval so fast?

hi: Wo query aur doc ko ek saath model me daalta hai
Wo GPU pe hi chalta hai
Document vectors offline precompute ho jaate hain, query time pe sirf query encode hoti hai
en: It feeds query and doc into the model together
Document vectors are precomputed offline; only the query is encoded at query time

why.hi: Bi-encoder query aur doc alag encode karta hai, isliye docs ke vectors pehle se ban jaate hain aur ANN se fast search hota hai.
why.en: A bi-encoder encodes query and doc separately, so doc vectors are built ahead of time and ANN search is fast.

q.hi: Bi-encoder ki ranking imprecise kyun hoti hai?
q.en: Why is bi-encoder ranking imprecise?

hi: Query aur doc ke tokens kabhi ek saath attend nahi hote, sirf gist-to-gist compare
Wo sirf 384 dims use karta hai
ANN hamesha galat neighbours deta hai
en: Query and doc tokens never attend to each other, only gist-to-gist comparison
Cosine similarity is the wrong metric

why.hi: Docs query ke bina independently encode hote hain; precise ranking ke liye cross-encoder reranker chahiye.
why.en: Docs are encoded independently of the query; precise ranking needs a cross-encoder reranker.

q.hi: Embedding model chunne ka sabse reliable tareeka?
q.en: Most reliable way to choose an embedding model?

hi: Apne golden query set pe recall@k compare karna
en: The top model on the MTEB leaderboard
The model with the most dimensions
Comparing recall@k on your own golden query set

why.hi: Leaderboard sirf starting point; apne domain aur queries pe eval karke cost/latency ke saath decide karo.
why.en: The leaderboard is only a starting point; evaluate on your domain and queries, then weigh cost/latency.

q.hi: Recursive chunking kaise todta hai?
q.en: How does recursive chunking split text?

hi: Har N characters pe bina dekhe
Pehle bade separator (paragraph), phir chhote (line, sentence) jab tak size limit me na aaye
en: Bigger separator first (paragraph), then smaller (line, sentence) until within the size limit

why.hi:
Recursive splitter natural boundaries respect karta hai: 

 → 
 → sentence → word.
why.en:
A recursive splitter respects natural boundaries: 

 → 
 → sentence → word.

q.hi: Bahut bade chunks (jaise 1500 tokens) ka main nuksaan?
q.en: Main downside of very large chunks (e.g. 1500 tokens)?

hi: Embedding kai topics ka average ban jaata hai aur precise retrieval nahi hota
LLM ko context kam milta hai
en: The embedding becomes an average of many topics, hurting precise retrieval

why.hi: Bada chunk = blurred embedding + prompt me noise; chhota chunk = sharp par context kam.
why.en: Big chunk = blurred embedding + noise in the prompt; small chunk = sharp but less context.

q.hi: Chunks ke beech overlap kyun rakhte hain?
q.en: Why keep overlap between chunks?

hi: Boundary pe pada sentence kat ke lost na ho
en: So a sentence on the boundary is not lost to the cut

why.hi: Overlap boundary text ko dono chunks me rakhta hai; zyada overlap storage aur cost badhata hai.
why.en: Overlap keeps boundary text in both chunks; too much overlap raises storage and cost.

q.hi: Parent-child (small-to-big) retrieval me kya hota hai?
q.en: What happens in parent-child (small-to-big) retrieval?

hi: Bade parents pe search, chhote children LLM ko
Parent aur child dono same index me embed
Chhote child chunks pe search, unka bada parent section LLM ko
en: Search big parents, give small children to the LLM
Embed parents and children in the same index
Search small child chunks, give their larger parent section to the LLM

why.hi: Search small for precision, serve big for context; child ke metadata me parent_id hota hai.
why.en: Search small for precision, serve big for context; each child stores a parent_id in metadata.

q.hi: Chunk 'iski limit 10 din hai' retrieve nahi ho raha. Sabse achha fix?
q.en: The chunk 'its limit is 10 days' is not getting retrieved. Best fix?

hi: Chunk ke aage heading path / doc context prepend karo
en: Prepend the heading path / doc context to the chunk

why.hi: Heading path (jaise 'HR Policy > Leave > Maternity') jodne se chunk ka topic embedding me aa jaata hai (contextual chunking).
why.en: Prepending the heading path (e.g. 'HR Policy > Leave > Maternity') puts the chunk's topic into its embedding (contextual chunking).

q.hi: Semantic chunking ka split point kaise decide hota hai?
q.en: How does semantic chunking decide split points?

hi: Consecutive sentences ki embedding similarity achanak girne pe
en: Where embedding similarity between consecutive sentences drops sharply

why.hi: Semantic chunking topic shift detect karta hai; ingestion pe extra embedding cost lagta hai.
why.en: Semantic chunking detects topic shifts; it adds extra embedding cost at ingestion.

q.hi: Query me exact error code `ERR_CONN_RESET_4XX` hai. Dense-only search kyun fail ho sakta hai?
q.en: A query contains the exact error code `ERR_CONN_RESET_4XX`. Why can dense-only search fail?

hi: Embedding exact identifier ki specificity average out kar deta hai
Vector DB special characters store nahi kar sakta
Cosine similarity sirf English words pe kaam karti hai
ANN index me code wala page kabhi insert hi nahi hota
en: The embedding averages out the specificity of the exact identifier
Vector DBs cannot store special characters
Cosine similarity only works on English words
The page with the code is never inserted into the ANN index

why.hi: Ye vocabulary mismatch problem hai: embedding meaning pakadta hai, rare exact token ko nahi. BM25 ka high IDF use #1 pe laata hai.
why.en: This is the vocabulary mismatch problem: embeddings capture meaning, not a rare exact token. BM25's high IDF puts it at #1.

q.hi: k=60 ke saath RRF. Doc X dense me rank 1 aur sparse me rank 4 pe; doc Y dense me rank 3 aur sparse me rank 1 pe. Kaun upar aayega?
q.en: RRF with k=60. Doc X is rank 1 in dense and rank 4 in sparse; doc Y is rank 3 in dense and rank 1 in sparse. Which ranks higher?

hi: X, kyunki dense ka #1 hamesha jeet-ta hai
Dono ka score bilkul barabar hoga
Raw scores ke bina decide nahi ho sakta
en: Both get exactly the same score
It can't be decided without the raw scores

why.hi: Y = 0.0323, X = 0.0320. Dono lists me consistently upar rehna ek list me #1 hone se zyada value deta hai.
why.en: Y = 0.0323, X = 0.0320. Being consistently high in both lists is worth more than being #1 in one.

q.hi: BM25 aur cosine scores ko min-max normalize karke add karne ke bajaye RRF kyun prefer kiya jaata hai?
q.en: Why is RRF preferred over min-max normalizing and adding BM25 and cosine scores?

hi: RRF scores ko GPU pe compute karta hai
RRF sirf rank use karta hai, alag scales aur outliers ka asar nahi
RRF BM25 ko completely ignore karta hai
RRF ko har corpus ke liye labeled data chahiye
en: RRF computes scores on a GPU
RRF uses only ranks, so different scales and outliers don't matter
RRF needs labeled data for every corpus

why.hi: BM25 (0–15) aur cosine (0.6–0.95) ke distributions alag hain; ek outlier min-max ko bigaad deta hai. RRF rank-based hai, normalization nahi chahiye.
why.en: BM25 (0–15) and cosine (0.6–0.95) have different distributions; one outlier breaks min-max. RRF is rank-based and needs no normalization.

q.hi: 80-document pilot pe hybrid (RRF k=60) dense-only se bhi bura de raha hai. Sabse pehla sensible fix?
q.en: On an 80-document pilot, hybrid (RRF k=60) is doing worse than dense-only. What is the first sensible fix?

why.hi: k=60 bade corpus ke liye tuned hai; chhote corpus pe rank differences zyada meaningful hote hain, isliye steeper k=10–20. Author ka pilot k=10 pe theek hua.
why.en: k=60 is tuned for large corpora; on small ones rank differences mean more, so use a steeper k=10–20. The author's pilot was fixed with k=10.

q.hi: SPLADE ke baare me kaunsa statement sahi hai?
q.en: Which statement about SPLADE is correct?

hi: Ye learned sparse vectors banata hai aur related terms pe bhi weight deta hai
Ye ek dense 768-dim embedding model hai
Ye BM25 ka naya naam hai, koi model nahi
Ye naye internal error codes pe BM25 se hamesha better hai
en: It produces learned sparse vectors and also puts weight on related terms
It is a dense 768-dim embedding model
It is just a new name for BM25, not a model
It is always better than BM25 on new internal error codes

why.hi: SPLADE vocab-size sparse vector deta hai with term expansion (car → vehicle). Out-of-vocabulary naye codes pe BM25 better hai.
why.en: SPLADE gives a vocab-size sparse vector with term expansion (car → vehicle). For new out-of-vocabulary codes BM25 is better.

q.hi: Legal contracts ka corpus jisme clause numbers bahut hain. Hybrid me kya tune karoge?
q.en: A corpus of legal contracts full of clause numbers. What would you tune in hybrid?

hi: Sparse retriever hata ke sirf dense rakho
Sparse ko zyada candidates do, e.g. sparse top-100, dense top-30
BM25 aur dense ko sequentially chalao
en: Drop sparse and keep only dense
Give sparse more candidates, e.g. sparse top-100, dense top-30

why.hi: Jargon/identifier-heavy corpus me sparse signal zyada reliable hai, isliye usko zyada weight/candidates. Sequential chalana sirf latency badhata hai.
why.en: In jargon/identifier-heavy corpora the sparse signal is more reliable, so give it more weight/candidates. Running sequentially only adds latency.

q.hi: Bi-encoder aur cross-encoder ka core difference kya hai?
q.en: What is the core difference between a bi-encoder and a cross-encoder?

hi: Bi-encoder sirf images ke liye hota hai
Cross-encoder query aur doc ko saath me ek model me daal ke cross-attention karta hai
Cross-encoder ke doc embeddings offline precompute ho jaate hain
Bi-encoder har query pe har doc ke saath forward pass karta hai
en: A bi-encoder is only for images
A cross-encoder feeds query and doc together into one model with cross-attention
A cross-encoder's doc embeddings are precomputed offline
A bi-encoder does a forward pass with every doc per query

why.hi: Bi-encoder alag-alag encode karta hai (precompute, fast). Cross-encoder `[CLS] query [SEP] doc` joint score karta hai: accurate par O(N) per query.
why.en: A bi-encoder encodes separately (precomputed, fast). A cross-encoder scores `[CLS] query [SEP] doc` jointly: accurate but O(N) per query.

q.hi: Two-stage pipeline me sensible default numbers kya hain?
q.en: What are sensible default numbers in a two-stage pipeline?

en: Retrieve 1000, send all to the LLM

why.hi: N >> K chahiye: N=50 recall ke liye, K=3–7 precision aur token cost ke liye. 100 se upar N rarely help karta hai.
why.en: You need N >> K: N=50 for recall, K=3–7 for precision and token cost. N above 100 rarely helps.

q.hi: CPU-only infra, sub-200ms SLA. Kaunsa reranker sabse practical start hai?
q.en: CPU-only infra, sub-200ms SLA. Which reranker is the most practical start?

hi: FlashRank (quantized small model, ~15–30ms for 50 on CPU)
en: FlashRank (quantized small model, ~15–30ms for 50 on CPU)

why.hi: FlashRank CPU pe ~20ms me roughly 85–90% cross-encoder quality deta hai. LLM reranking seconds leta hai; Cohere 150–400ms + network aur p99 spikes.
why.en: FlashRank gives roughly 85–90% of cross-encoder quality in ~20ms on CPU. LLM reranking takes seconds; Cohere is 150–400ms + network with p99 spikes.

q.hi: Pipeline me HyDE se query rewrite hoti hai. Reranker ko kaunsi query deni chahiye?
q.en: The pipeline rewrites queries with HyDE. Which query should go to the reranker?

hi: Koi query nahi, sirf doc scores
en: A concatenation of rewritten and original

why.hi: Reranker ko judge karna hai ki doc user ke asli sawaal ka jawab deta hai ya nahi; rewritten/HyDE query dene se subtle ranking errors aate hain.
why.en: The reranker must judge whether a doc answers the user's actual question; passing the rewritten/HyDE query causes subtle ranking errors.

q.hi: NDCG@5 low hai. Gold answer top-50 candidates me maujood hai par neeche score hua. Problem kahan hai?
q.en: NDCG@5 is low. The gold answer is in the top-50 candidates but scored low. Where is the problem?

why.hi: Gold top-50 me nahi → retrieval problem. Top-50 me hai par neeche → reranker problem (model, domain mismatch, truncation).
why.en: Gold not in top-50 → retrieval problem. In top-50 but low → reranker problem (model, domain mismatch, truncation).

q.hi: Kis case me reranking add karna sabse kam worth hai?
q.en: In which case is adding reranking least worth it?

hi: Long complex queries, noisy dense-only retrieval
Bada corpus jahan gold chunk aksar position 3–5 pe aata hai
Medical Q&A jahan precision critical hai
Real-time autocomplete jahan 20ms bhi zyada hai aur answer already #1 pe hai
en: Long complex queries with noisy dense-only retrieval
A large corpus where the gold chunk often lands at position 3–5
Medical Q&A where precision is critical
Real-time autocomplete where even 20ms is too much and the answer is already #1

why.hi: Tight latency budget aur already-#1 results pe reranker sirf latency add karta hai. Baaki teen cases me reranking ka gain sabse zyada hota hai.
why.en: With a tight latency budget and results already at #1, the reranker only adds latency. The other three are where reranking gains most.

q.hi: PageIndex ka core idea kya hai?
q.en: What is the core idea of PageIndex?

hi: Document ke natural structure (pages/sections) ko retrieval unit banana
Sirf BM25 use karna, embeddings kabhi nahi
Har sentence ka alag embedding banana
en: Make the document's natural structure (pages/sections) the retrieval unit
Create a separate embedding for every sentence

why.hi: Chunking ko random strips me kaatne jaisa samjho; PageIndex binding pe kaat-ta hai, jahan author ne khud boundaries rakhi.
why.en: Think of chunking as cutting into random strips; PageIndex cuts at the binding, where the author placed the boundaries.

q.hi: Vectorless tree-index retrieval me sahi section kaise milta hai?
q.en: In vectorless tree-index retrieval, how is the right section found?

hi: HNSW graph pe cosine search se
LLM ToC-jaise tree pe reason karke node choose aur descend karta hai
BM25 se tree ke saare nodes score karke
en: Via cosine search on an HNSW graph
The LLM reasons over a ToC-like tree, choosing and descending into nodes
By scoring every tree node with BM25

why.hi: Tree nodes pe titles + summaries hote hain; LLM human analyst ki tarah 'answer kahan hona chahiye' socha ke navigate karta hai, embeddings nahi.
why.en: Tree nodes carry titles + summaries; the LLM navigates like a human analyst reasoning 'where should the answer be', with no embeddings.

q.hi: PageIndex kis use case me sabse kam fit hai?
q.en: For which use case is PageIndex the worst fit?

hi: Technical manual with tables spanning pages
Chhote uniform FAQ entries ka collection
en: A legal contract with cross-page clauses
A technical manual with tables spanning pages
A collection of short uniform FAQ entries

why.hi: Rule: print karke page-by-page padhne wale docs → PageIndex; scan aur search wale chhote docs → chunking theek hai, PageIndex overkill.
why.en: Rule: docs made to be printed and read page by page → PageIndex; short scan-and-search docs → chunking is fine, PageIndex is overkill.

q.hi: Vectorless tree retrieval ka sabse bada trade-off kya hai?
q.en: What is the biggest trade-off of vectorless tree retrieval?

hi: Har query pe kai LLM calls: zyada latency aur cost, aur bahut saare docs pe scale nahi
Ye answers ke saath page citations nahi de sakta
Isme vector DB ka cost sabse zyada hota hai
Ye sirf scanned PDFs pe kaam karta hai
en: Several LLM calls per query: more latency and cost, and it doesn't scale across many docs
It cannot give page citations with answers
It has the highest vector DB cost
It only works on scanned PDFs

why.hi: Tree navigation me multiple reasoning steps lagte hain (seconds). Explainability high hai, par pehle doc select karna padta hai bade collections pe.
why.en: Tree navigation needs several reasoning steps (seconds). Explainability is high, but on large collections you must select the doc first.

q.hi: Page-level index me top-K pages LLM ko kis order me dene chahiye?
q.en: In a page-level index, in what order should the top-K pages go to the LLM?

hi: Random order, taaki bias na ho
Page order, kyunki narrative structure matter karta hai
en: Page order, because narrative structure matters

why.hi: Article ka recommendation: retrieval score se select karo, par context page order me assemble karo taaki cross-page flow bana rahe.
why.en: The article's recommendation: select by retrieval score, but assemble the context in page order so the cross-page flow stays intact.

q.hi: Ek page 1,500+ words ka hai aur embedding token limit cross ho rahi hai. Article ka suggested fix?
q.en: A page has 1,500+ words and exceeds the embedding token limit. What fix does the article suggest?

hi: Pehle ~800 tokens + aakhri ~200 tokens embed karo
Page ko 10 random chunks me tod ke unka average lo
en: Embed the first ~800 tokens + the last ~200 tokens
Split into 10 random chunks and average them

why.hi: 'Semantic bookends' page ka intro aur conclusion pakadte hain; careless truncation embedding ko corrupt karta hai.
why.en: 'Semantic bookends' capture the page's intro and conclusion; careless truncation corrupts the embedding.

q.hi: HyDE technique me search kis cheez ke embedding se hota hai?
q.en: In HyDE, what is embedded and used for the search?

hi: LLM ke likhe hypothetical answer se
en: A hypothetical answer written by the LLM

why.hi: HyDE me LLM pehle ek fake answer likhta hai; answer jaisa text real answer chunks ke zyada paas hota hai.
why.en: In HyDE the LLM first writes a fake answer; answer-like text sits closer to real answer chunks.

q.hi: Parent-child (small-to-big) retrieval ka main idea kya hai?
q.en: What is the main idea of parent-child (small-to-big) retrieval?

hi: Bade chunks se search, chhote LLM ko
Chhote chunks se search, bada parent LLM ko
Child chunks ko delete karke index chhota karna
en: Search with big chunks, give small ones to the LLM
Search with small chunks, give the bigger parent to the LLM
Delete child chunks to shrink the index

why.hi: Chhota chunk precise match deta hai, bada parent LLM ko poora context.
why.en: Small chunks give precise matches; the bigger parent gives the LLM full context.

q.hi: 'Lost in the middle' ka matlab kya hai?
q.en: What does 'lost in the middle' mean?

hi: LLM context ke beech wali info ko sabse kam use karta hai
Vector DB beech ke chunks index nahi karta
Reranker beech ke candidates skip karta hai
Chunking me document ka middle part kho jaata hai
en: LLMs use information in the middle of the context the least
The vector DB doesn't index middle chunks
Chunking loses the middle of the document

why.hi: Models start aur end ki info best use karte hain; isliye kam, reranked chunks bhejo.
why.en: Models use start and end information best, so send fewer, reranked chunks.

q.hi: Chat me follow-up 'aur uska?' ke liye sabse sasta fix kya hai?
q.en: What is the cheapest fix for a chat follow-up like 'and that one?'

why.hi: Rewriting follow-up ko standalone search query bana deta hai, ek chhoti LLM call me.
why.en: Rewriting turns the follow-up into a standalone search query with one small LLM call.

q.hi: GraphRAG kis tarah ke question pe sabse zyada help karta hai?
q.en: Which kind of question does GraphRAG help with most?

hi: Poore dataset ke main themes jaise global questions
en: Global questions like main themes across the dataset
A short query with a typo

why.hi: Community summaries global questions answer karte hain jahan top-k chunks kaafi nahi.
why.en: Community summaries answer global questions where top-k chunks are not enough.

q.hi: Contextual retrieval me indexing ke time kya kiya jaata hai?
q.en: What does contextual retrieval do at indexing time?

hi: Chunks ko compress karke chhota karna
Har chunk ko do models se embed karna
Har chunk ke aage uske document ka short context jodna
Chunks ko graph me convert karna
en: Compress chunks to make them smaller
Embed each chunk with two models
Prepend short document context to each chunk

why.hi: 1-2 line context se akela chunk bhi samajh aata hai aur better retrieve hota hai.
why.en: 1-2 lines of context make a lone chunk understandable and better retrievable.

q.hi: Gold chunk rank 4 pe aaya. Us query ka reciprocal rank kya hai?
q.en: The gold chunk is at rank 4. What is that query's reciprocal rank?

why.hi: Reciprocal rank = 1/rank = 1/4 = 0.25.
why.en: Reciprocal rank = 1/rank = 1/4 = 0.25.

q.hi: Context sahi tha par answer me unsupported claims hain. Kaunsa metric low hoga?
q.en: The context was right but the answer has unsupported claims. Which metric is low?

why.hi: Faithfulness check karta hai ki har claim context se supported hai ya nahi.
why.en: Faithfulness checks whether every claim is supported by the context.

q.hi: Recall@50 bahut kam hai. Reranker add karne se kya hoga?
q.en: Recall@50 is very low. What will adding a reranker do?

hi: Zyada help nahi; jo chunk aaya hi nahi use rerank nahi kar sakte
en: It will fully solve the problem
Little help; you can't rerank a chunk that never arrived

why.hi: Reranker sirf candidates ka order badalta hai; pehle retrieval recall fix karo.
why.en: A reranker only reorders candidates; fix retrieval recall first.

q.hi: Notes ke hisaab se useful golden set ka rough size kya hai?
q.en: Per the notes, what is a rough useful golden set size?

why.hi: Real logs se 50-100 annotated pairs bhi meaningful signal dete hain.
why.en: Even 50-100 annotated pairs from real logs give meaningful signal.

q.hi: nDCG, MRR se kis baat me alag hai?
q.en: How does nDCG differ from MRR?

hi: nDCG graded relevance aur saare relevant results ki position count karta hai
nDCG sirf generation ke liye hai
nDCG ko ground truth nahi chahiye
en: nDCG counts graded relevance and positions of all relevant results

why.hi: MRR sirf pehle relevant result ko dekhta hai; nDCG graded relevance with position discount.
why.en: MRR looks only at the first relevant result; nDCG uses graded relevance with a position discount.

q.hi: Inme se kaunsa online evaluation signal hai?
q.en: Which of these is an online evaluation signal?

hi: Production me thumbs-down aur regenerate rate
en: Thumbs-down and regenerate rate in production

why.hi: Online eval real users ke production signals se hota hai; baaki offline hain.
why.en: Online eval uses real users' production signals; the others are offline.

q.hi: 200-page PDF ingest ke liye API ko kya return karna chahiye?
q.en: What should the API return for a 200-page PDF ingest?

hi: 202 Accepted with job_id, kaam worker kare
en: 202 Accepted with a job_id, a worker does the work

why.hi: Ingestion minutes leta hai; proxies 60-100s pe kaat dete hain, isliye async job.
why.en: Ingestion takes minutes and proxies cut at 60-100s, so use an async job.

q.hi: SSE stream me saare tokens end me ek saath aa rahe hain. Sabse likely wajah?
q.en: All SSE tokens arrive at once at the end. Most likely cause?

why.hi: proxy_buffering off aur X-Accel-Buffering: no set karna padta hai.
why.en: You must set proxy_buffering off and X-Accel-Buffering: no.

q.hi: Embedding cache key me model name aur version kyun?
q.en: Why include model name and version in the embedding cache key?

hi: Model badalne pe cache apne aap invalid ho
Redis ko fast karne ke liye
en: So the cache auto-invalidates on a model change

why.hi: Alag model ke vectors comparable nahi; key me version se purane entries use nahi hote.
why.en: Vectors from different models aren't comparable; the version in the key avoids stale entries.

q.hi: Multi-tenant RAG me permission check kahan hona chahiye?
q.en: Where should the permission check live in multi-tenant RAG?

hi: LLM ke prompt me 'mat dikhana' likh ke
Answer ke baad output filter me
Retrieval me metadata pre-filter ke roop me
en: In the LLM prompt saying 'don't show it'
In an output filter after the answer
As a metadata pre-filter during retrieval

why.hi: LLM ko woh chunk milna hi nahi chahiye jo user nahi dekh sakta.
why.en: The LLM should never receive a chunk the user isn't allowed to see.

q.hi: Embedding API 429 pe retry me jitter kyun zaroori hai?
q.en: Why is jitter important when retrying embedding API 429s?

hi: Saare clients ek saath retry karke retry storm na banayein
Cache hit rate badhane ke liye
en: So all clients don't retry together and cause a retry storm

why.hi: Random delay retries ko spread karta hai; notes me ye sabse bada stability win tha.
why.en: Random delay spreads retries; in the notes it was the biggest stability win.

q.hi: RAG API me workers ko kis basis pe autoscale karna chahiye?
q.en: What should ingestion workers autoscale on in a RAG API?

why.hi: Workers CPU/memory heavy hain aur queue se kaam lete hain; API HTTP load pe scale hota hai.
why.en: Workers are CPU/memory heavy and pull from the queue; the API scales on HTTP load.

q.hi: Company ki fresh, private knowledge + citations ke liye default choice?
q.en: Default choice for fresh, private company knowledge + citations?

why.hi: RAG data update sasta rakhta hai aur sources cite kar sakta hai; fine-tuning style ke liye hai.
why.en: RAG keeps data updates cheap and can cite sources; fine-tuning is for style.

q.hi: Queries me SKU codes aur error codes bahut hain. Kya add karoge?
q.en: Queries contain many SKU and error codes. What do you add?

why.hi: Dense exact terms miss karta hai; BM25 unhe pakadta hai, RRF se merge.
why.en: Dense misses exact terms; BM25 catches them, merged with RRF.

q.hi: Bi-encoder vs cross-encoder: sahi statement?
q.en: Bi-encoder vs cross-encoder: which is correct?

hi: Cross-encoder retrieval ke liye pre-compute hota hai
Bi-encoder query aur doc saath padhta hai
Cross-encoder query aur doc saath padhta hai, accurate par slow
en: A cross-encoder is pre-computed for retrieval
A bi-encoder reads query and doc together
A cross-encoder reads query and doc together, accurate but slow

why.hi: Isliye bi-encoder retrieval me, cross-encoder sirf rerank me.
why.en: That's why bi-encoders are used for retrieval and cross-encoders only for reranking.

q.hi: Embedding model badalna hai. Sahi tarika?
q.en: You need to change the embedding model. Right approach?

hi: Sirf naye docs naye model se embed karo
Purane vectors ko normalize kar do
Query ko dono models se embed karke average
Naye index me sab re-embed, eval, phir alias switch
en: Embed only new docs with the new model
Embed the query with both models and average
Re-embed everything into a new index, eval, then switch an alias

why.hi: Alag models ke vectors comparable nahi; blue-green re-index safe hai.
why.en: Vectors from different models aren't comparable; a blue-green re-index is safe.

q.hi: RAG ke baad bhi hallucination ka ek common reason?
q.en: A common reason for hallucination even with RAG?

hi: Retrieval ne galat ya adhoora context diya
Vector DB me HNSW use hua
en: Retrieval returned wrong or partial context

why.hi: Kharab context pe model guess ya training knowledge pe chala jaata hai.
why.en: With bad context the model guesses or falls back on training knowledge.

q.hi: RAG chatbot HLD me senior signal ke liye kaunse do points khud se bolne chahiye?
q.en: Which two points should you raise yourself in a RAG chatbot HLD as a senior signal?

hi: Framework ka naam aur GPU type

why.hi: Zyada candidates ACL aur eval bhool jaate hain.
why.en: Most candidates forget ACLs and eval.
